sentences: AutoGen is an open-source framework that allows developers to build LLM applications via multiple agents that can converse with each other to accomplish tasks.
Both natural language and computer code can be used to program flexible conversation patterns for different applications.
Prior work suggests that multiple agents can help encourage divergent thinking (Liang et al., 2023), improve factuality and reasoning (Du et al., 2023), and provide validation (Wu et al., 2023).
Our insight is to use multi-agent conversations to achieve it.

Failing to adequately address these two questions would limit the framework’s scope of applicability and generality.
order: AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation
